summary_1line: Genealogy from Chyavana to Ruru and the discovery and upbringing of the abandoned girl Pramadvara by the sage Sthulakesa.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Sthulakesa discovers a radiant abandoned infant girl lying alone on the quiet bank of a river.
Menaka the celestial nymph leaves her newborn child beside the river and disappears back toward the heavens.
Young Ruru sees the beautiful Pramadvara in the hermitage of Sthulakesa and falls deeply in love.
